sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_ket_kt_analysis_incident_analysis</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>true</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Initialize Kepner Tregoe Incident Analys</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[function onDisplay(current, g_scratchpad) {
    //	Because this is a "display" rule, we must be careful not to create new related
    //	records every time we view the record, so first check to see if one exists
    var isIsNotGr = new GlideRecord("x_ket_kt_analysis_step_2_is_and_is_not");
    isIsNotGr.addQuery("parent", current.sys_id);
    isIsNotGr.query();
    if (isIsNotGr.next()) {
        return; //	We already have related records associated, so exit early
    }

    //	Build list of related "Step 1" records
    insertColumnType("A1. What Object");
    insertColumnType("A2. What Deviation");
    insertColumnType("B1. Where Geographically");
    insertColumnType("B2. Where On The Object");
    insertColumnType("C1. When First");
    insertColumnType("C2. When Since");
    //	insertColumnType( "C3. What Pattern" );
    insertColumnType("C3. When In The Lifecycle");
    insertColumnType("D1. Number of Objects and Trend");
    insertColumnType("D2. Size of Deviations and Trend");
    insertColumnType("D3. Deviations per Object and Trend");
}

//	Insert related record and attach to parent Incident Analysis
function insertColumnType(columnName) {
    var insertGr = new GlideRecord("x_ket_kt_analysis_step_2_is_and_is_not");
    insertGr.initialize();
    insertGr.type = columnName;
    insertGr.parent = current.sys_id;
    insertGr.insert();
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>grant.hulbert</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2016-06-30 21:01:01</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>a3edc416db50a60070d7f5f0cf96194b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>12</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Initialize Kepner Tregoe Incident Analys</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="KT Analysis" source="x_ket_kt_analysis">4525b811dbd4660070d7f5f0cf961946</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="KT Analysis">4525b811dbd4660070d7f5f0cf961946</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_a3edc416db50a60070d7f5f0cf96194b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>jbochnak</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2023-01-31 20:47:35</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before_display</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=a3edc416db50a60070d7f5f0cf96194b"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_fix_18ebfd192f7dc0508742e0252e99b666
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><before>false</before><description>Migrate Milestone choice values to Milestone Choices table</description><name>Migrate Milestone Choices</name><record_for_rollback>false</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[runScript1();

function runScript1() {
	// Migrate values from sys_choice table Milestones Choices
	var gr0 = new GlideRecord("x_ket_kt_analysis_milestone_choices");
	gr0.setLimit(1);
	gr0.query();
	if (gr0.hasNext()) {
		gs.info("Milestone migration skipped - table has records");
		return;
	}
// Create records in Milestone Choices table from sys_choice values
	var gr1 = new GlideRecord("sys_choice");
	gr1.addEncodedQuery("name=x_ket_kt_analysis_milestones^element=key_event^inactive=false");
	gr1.query();
	var seq = 10;
	while (gr1.next()) {
		var ms_choice = new GlideRecord("x_ket_kt_analysis_milestone_choices");
		ms_choice.initialize();
		ms_choice.active = 'true';
		ms_choice.sequence = seq;
		ms_choice.choice = gr1.label;
		ms_choice.insert();
		seq = seq + 10;
	}

// Populate Key Event reference on every Milestone record 
	runScript2();

}

// Update Milestone Key Event reference field with value from Milestone Choices table
function runScript2() {
	var ms_rec = new GlideRecord("x_ket_kt_analysis_milestones");
	ms_rec.query();
	while (ms_rec.next()) {
		ms_rec.key_event_reference = getMilestoneValue(ms_rec.key_event);
		ms_rec.update();
	}
}

// Retrieve the sysid of the value from the Milestone Choices table
function getMilestoneValue(lookup) {
	var ms_value = new GlideRecord("x_ket_kt_analysis_milestone_choices");
	ms_value.addQuery("choice", lookup);
	ms_value.query();
	if (ms_value.next()) {
		return ms_value.sys_id;
	}
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jbochnak</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2019-12-17 17:02:54</sys_created_on><sys_id>18ebfd192f7dc0508742e0252e99b666</sys_id><sys_mod_count>16</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Migrate Milestone Choices</sys_name><sys_package display_value="KT Analysis" source="x_ket_kt_analysis">4525b811dbd4660070d7f5f0cf961946</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="KT Analysis">4525b811dbd4660070d7f5f0cf961946</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_18ebfd192f7dc0508742e0252e99b666</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>jbochnak</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2020-01-13 16:17:55</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>
